description: Kevin Murray and Wesley Michalski opened the Red Hook Pinball Museum in Brooklyn, New York's Red Hook neighborhood a little over a year ago, and now it boasts nearly two dozen analog pinball machines from the 1930s to the 1970s. "Taking a game that doesn't work at all, spending hundreds of hours getting it back together," Michalski told Inside Edition Digital, "and then all of a sudden you plug it in and it works again…that really feels like magic."
title: 'You Can Feel The Electromagnets Firing Under Your Hands' At NYC Pinball Museum
